acceptance_criteria.criterion: CargoSizeExtractor::__construct() has a third parameter BuildConfig $buildConfig.
CargoSizeBuildTools::build() passes self::getConfig() as the third argument to CargoSizeExtractor.
FileCollection::setConfig($this->buildConfig) is called within CargoSizeExtractor::extract() before FOMOD file creation.
composer build runs to completion with no errors.
composer analyze passes with no new errors.

summary: Added BuildConfig import and private BuildConfig $buildConfig property to CargoSizeExtractor.
Updated CargoSizeExtractor::__construct() with a third required parameter BuildConfig $buildConfig, stored as private property.
Updated CargoSizeBuildTools::build() to pass self::getConfig() as the third argument to new CargoSizeExtractor().
Added FileCollection::setConfig(BuildConfig $config): void static method alongside the existing reset() method.
Added private static ?BuildConfig $buildConfig = null property (with @phpstan-ignore annotation — read path deferred to WP-003).
Called FileCollection::setConfig($this->buildConfig) in CargoSizeExtractor::extract() immediately after FileCollection::reset().
All 47 PHPUnit tests pass. PHPStan 51/51 clean. composer build exits 0.

comments.note: Added @phpstan-ignore property.onlyWritten annotation on FileCollection::$buildConfig because the read path is intentionally deferred to WP-003 (getExampleShipDescription()). The annotation comment documents this so it will be removed when WP-003 lands.

notes: WP-002 complete. FileCollection::setConfig() stub is live and called from extract(). WP-003 can now add the deterministic lookup in getExampleShipDescription() — once it reads $buildConfig, the @phpstan-ignore annotation on the property should be removed.
